world.title: Trouble ahead of midterm elections? Americans are turning against Donald Trump's handling of economy, prices
world.summary: A recent poll indicates growing dissatisfaction among Americans regarding President Donald Trump's management of the economy and inflation. His economic approval ratings have significantly declined, with a majority expressing discontent over rising prices. This shift in public sentiment could pose challenges for Trump ahead of the upcoming midterm elections, as economic issues remain a critical concern for voters.

world.title: Iran’s Araghchi leaves US after talks stall: Did Rubio order delegation out? Washington says they ‘overstayed’
world.summary: Iran's delegation departed New York as planned, while a US official stated they had "overstayed their welcome." This discrepancy highlights ongoing tensions between the two nations regarding the resumption of nuclear talks. Reports suggest Senator Marco Rubio may have influenced the decision to expel the Iranian delegation, further complicating the already strained diplomatic relations between Washington and Tehran.

world.title: Indian-origin truck driver jailed for 6 years in Canada after fatal crash that killed mom, 11-year-old son
world.summary: Baljeet Singh, a 30-year-old Indian-origin truck driver, was sentenced to six years in prison by a Quebec court after admitting to playing a mobile game while driving. His distraction caused a seven-vehicle pileup, resulting in the deaths of a mother and her 11-year-old son, along with multiple injuries to others involved in the crash.

business.title: Ace investor Shankar Sharma decodes market performance, highlights where money-making opportunities lie
business.summary: Investor Shankar Sharma analyzes the Indian stock market's recent downturn, noting an 18% decline from its peak in January. He attributes this to a period of negligible returns following previous strong performance. Sharma encourages investors to seek alternative opportunities, particularly in fixed income, as market dynamics shift. He emphasizes the importance of adapting investment strategies in the current environment.

business.title: Kia India Sep 2026 Sales At New High Of 32k Units - Seltos, Sonet Lead, Sorento Joins The Party
business.summary: Kia India achieved record monthly sales in September 2026, reaching 32,000 units, marking a 41% year-on-year growth. Quarterly sales increased by 38.51%, while total volumes from January to September surpassed 253,000 units. The Seltos and Sonet models led sales, with the Sorento also contributing to the overall performance, reflecting strong demand in the Indian automotive market.

business.title: Oil Rises as China Fuel Supply Concerns Mount
business.summary: Crude oil prices rose above $91 a barrel on Thursday due to concerns over tighter fuel supplies in China, exacerbating global market disruptions. Reports indicate that PetroChina has withdrawn multiple gasoline and jet-fuel cargoes planned for October, as Beijing aims to preserve domestic inventory. This situation has heightened worries about the stability of global oil supply chains.

technology.title: CD Projekt Red Drops First Lighting Adjustments For The Witcher 3 Remastered, While a New Mod Makes Settings Tuning Painless
technology.summary: CD Projekt Red released patch 5.00b for The Witcher 3 Remastered, introducing lighting adjustments and a Real-Time Graphics Menu Preview mod. Shortly after, a hotfix, 5.00c, was launched to address additional issues, notably enhancing performance for NVIDIA Hairworks. These updates aim to improve the gaming experience by refining visual elements and providing easier settings tuning for players.

technology.title: WhatsApp introduces parental controls for pre
technology.summary: WhatsApp is launching global parental controls aimed at managing pre-teens' contacts and groups, as well as teens' privacy settings, Meta AI access, Status, and Channels. The new features include parent-managed accounts for pre-teens, enabling parents or guardians to oversee who can contact their children. This rollout is taking place gradually across various regions worldwide.

technology.title: iPhone 17 at Rs 84900 in Flipkart sale: 2 reasons to buy it before price goes back to Rs 1 lakh
technology.summary: Flipkart will offer the iPhone 17 at Rs 84,999 during its Big Billion Days sale starting October 9, a significant reduction from the current price of Rs 99,900. This discount is attributed to ongoing pressure on smartphone pricing due to memory costs. Consumers are encouraged to purchase the device before the price returns to approximately Rs 1 lakh.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Day 14: Full October 2 schedule, IST timings and Indians in action
sports.summary: On October 2, Day 14 of the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, Indian athletes will compete in 12 disciplines, including archery, boxing, wrestling, cycling, hockey, and taekwondo. The events feature multiple medal opportunities for India as participants aim to secure victories across various sports. The schedule includes specific timings in Indian Standard Time (IST).

sports.title: Faf du Plessis Trent Boult and Kieron Pollard in SA20 mini-auction shortlist
sports.summary: Faf du Plessis, Trent Boult, and Kieron Pollard are featured in the shortlist for the SA20 mini-auction, set for October 7. A total of 156 players will be available for selection, including notable South African cricketers like Imran Tahir and Rassie van der Dussen. The auction aims to enhance team rosters for the upcoming season.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026, Day 13 Wrap: India Win Five Medals; Men's Hockey & Cricket Teams Reach Finals
sports.summary: India's medal tally at the Asian Games 2026 reached 65, comprising 10 gold, 23 silver, and 32 bronze, securing a position in the top-10 standings. On Day 13, India won five medals, with notable achievements in skiff sailing and Greco-Roman wrestling. Additionally, both the men's hockey and cricket teams advanced to the finals, contributing to the overall success.

health.title: South Asia accounts for 84% of chewing tobacco deaths worldwide, Lancet study finds
health.summary: A Lancet study reveals that South Asia accounts for 84% of global chewing tobacco-related deaths. Analyzing data from 204 countries between 1990 and 2023, researchers found that despite advancements in tobacco control, global tobacco use has remained stable over the past two decades. Approximately 241 million individuals aged 15 and older are currently using chewing tobacco worldwide.

health.title: Symptoms, Myths & Early Detection
health.summary: Breast cancer rates among women under 50 are increasing globally, including in Pakistan. This trend challenges previous assumptions about the disease's onset age. Awareness of symptoms and debunking common myths are crucial for early detection, which significantly improves survival rates. Understanding these factors is essential for empowering younger women to recognize risks and seek timely medical attention.

science.title: Fossil teeth from ancient North American coastlines suggest some dinosaurs supplemented land diets with seaweed and other marine food, revealing a coastal feeding link that existed more than 100 milli
science.summary: Fossil teeth from ancient North American coastlines indicate that some dinosaurs may have supplemented their land diets with marine food, including seaweed. This discovery suggests a coastal feeding link existed over 100 million years ago. Researchers studied fossils from environments related to the Western Interior Seaway, an extensive inland sea that separated North America during the Cretaceous period.

science.title: Algae Based Biofuel Manufacturing Plant Setup in India
science.summary: India is establishing algae-based biofuel manufacturing plants, with setup costs ranging from INR 20-300 crore. These plants will have a capacity of 100-1,000 tons per day and a payback period of 6-10 years. This initiative aims to support the country’s clean energy transition, enhance biofuel blending efforts, and meet the growing demand for sustainable aviation fuel.

science.title: Moon Manufacturing: NASA Develops New Space Material
science.summary: NASA has developed a new material that combines biodegradable plastic with simulated lunar and Martian dust. This innovative material aims to assist astronauts in manufacturing and repairing equipment on the Moon and Mars, utilizing resources found on those celestial bodies. The advancement could enhance sustainability and efficiency in space exploration and support future missions to these environments.

entertainment.title: Swara Bhasker recalls director being inappropriate, banging on her door while drunk: ‘He asked for hug, I was scared’
entertainment.summary: Swara Bhasker shared an unsettling experience on the reality show Rise and Fall, recalling a director's inappropriate behavior after the success of Tanu Weds Manu. She described an incident where the director, intoxicated, banged on her door and requested a hug, leaving her feeling scared. Bhasker’s account highlights issues of misconduct in the film industry.

entertainment.title: "Just remember him leaving and the next time I saw him was in…": Nimrat Kaur recalls tragic loss of her father in Kashmir and how the tragedy shaped her understanding of loss
entertainment.summary: Actor Nimrat Kaur reflected on the loss of her father, Major Bhupender Singh, who was killed in a terror attack in Kashmir when she was 11 years old. She described the moment he left for duty and the profound impact his death had on her understanding of loss. Kaur's experience has shaped her perspective on grief and resilience.

entertainment.title: 'It Can't Be A Guy Killing Everyone...'
entertainment.summary: Abhishek Pathak emphasizes the importance of providing audiences with fresh experiences in "Drishyam The Conclusion," while maintaining emotional consistency. He believes that each installment should offer something new, avoiding repetitive storytelling. Pathak's approach focuses on evolving the narrative to engage viewers, ensuring that the franchise continues to resonate without losing the core emotional impact that fans expect.
